# Purpose

This notebook creates the advisor-meeting figures for the qFL-Chr.25
end-use evaluation manuscript.

This version incorporates the requested revisions:

- **Figure 1.2** added: QTL-positive vs QTL-negative trajectories across processing stages.
- **Figure 2** updated to explicitly report the FDR context.
- **Figure 3** updated to directly identify the NIIL pair within each background.
- **Figure 4** updated to use a **single overall regression line** per panel.
- **Figure 5** updated to use a biologically ordered yarn-trait axis.
- **Figure 6** updated with clearer interpretive notes for desirable negative differences.

All meeting figures are stored in:

`05_results/advisor_meeting_2026-09-21/figures`

Supporting figure tables are stored in:

`05_results/advisor_meeting_2026-09-21/tables`

# 3. Figure-saving helper

```{r save-helper}
save_meeting_figure <- function(
  plot_object,
  file_stub,
  width = 10,
  height = 7
) {

  png_file <- file.path(
    meeting_figure_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      ".png"
    )
  )

  pdf_file <- file.path(
    meeting_figure_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      ".pdf"
    )
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = png_file,
    plot = plot_object,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 400,
    bg = "white"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = pdf_file,
    plot = plot_object,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    device = grDevices::cairo_pdf
  )

  message(
    "Saved: ",
    basename(png_file),
    " and ",
    basename(pdf_file)
  )
}
```

# 4. Helper utilities

```{r helper-utilities}
first_existing_file <- function(
  directory,
  patterns
) {

  for (pattern in patterns) {
    hits <- list.files(
      directory,
      pattern = pattern,
      full.names = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )

    if (length(hits) > 0) {
      return(hits[[1]])
    }
  }

  return(NA_character_)
}

find_matching_column <- function(
  data_names,
  patterns
) {

  hits <- unique(
    unlist(
      purrr::map(
        patterns,
        ~ data_names[
          stringr::str_detect(
            data_names,
            stringr::regex(
              .x,
              ignore_case = TRUE
            )
          )
        ]
      )
    )
  )

  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  hits[[1]]
}

clean_identifier <- function(x) {
  x |>
    as.character() |>
    stringr::str_trim() |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "") |>
    dplyr::na_if("")
}
```

# 5. Import cleaned yarn data

```{r import-yarn}
yarn_file <- file.path(
  paths$data_processed,
  "yarn_2022_sample_level_clean.csv"
)

if (!file.exists(yarn_file)) {
  stop(
    "Missing cleaned yarn file:\n",
    yarn_file
  )
}

yarn <- readr::read_csv(
  yarn_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    background = factor(
      background,
      levels = c(
        "Acala",
        "Deltapine",
        "Georgia",
        "Paymaster"
      )
    ),
    qtl_status = factor(
      qtl_status,
      levels = c(
        "Negative",
        "Positive",
        "Parent_Check"
      )
    ),
    field_rep = factor(
      field_rep_inferred
    ),
    pair_id = interaction(
      background,
      nil_set,
      drop = TRUE
    )
  )

formal_yarn <- yarn |>
  dplyr::filter(
    material_type == "NIIL",
    qtl_status %in% c(
      "Negative",
      "Positive"
    )
  ) |>
  droplevels()

if (nrow(formal_yarn) != 64) {
  stop(
    "Expected 64 formal NIIL observations; found ",
    nrow(formal_yarn),
    "."
  )
}
```

# 6. Import matched 2022 fiber data

```{r import-fiber}
raw_matches <- list.files(
  paths$data_raw,
  pattern = "^2022 UGA Mini-Spin Raw Data.*\\.xlsx$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(raw_matches) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Expected exactly one 2022 UGA Mini-Spin Raw Data workbook in 02_data_raw."
  )
}

raw_file <- raw_matches[[1]]

raw_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(
  raw_file
)

sheet_dimensions <- purrr::map_dfr(
  raw_sheets,
  function(sheet_name) {

    temp <- tryCatch(
      readxl::read_excel(
        raw_file,
        sheet = sheet_name,
        n_max = 100,
        .name_repair = "unique_quiet"
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (is.null(temp)) {
      return(
        tibble::tibble(
          sheet = sheet_name,
          rows_read = NA_integer_,
          columns = NA_integer_
        )
      )
    }

    tibble::tibble(
      sheet = sheet_name,
      rows_read = nrow(temp),
      columns = ncol(temp)
    )
  }
)

candidate_sheets <- sheet_dimensions |>
  dplyr::filter(
    rows_read >= 90,
    columns >= 114
  )

if (nrow(candidate_sheets) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Could not uniquely identify the 2022 114-column analysis sheet."
  )
}

analysis_sheet <- candidate_sheets$sheet[[1]]

raw_unfiltered <- readxl::read_excel(
  raw_file,
  sheet = analysis_sheet,
  .name_repair = "unique_quiet"
)

genotype_check <- stringr::str_trim(
  as.character(
    raw_unfiltered[[1]]
  )
)

rep_check <- suppressWarnings(
  as.integer(
    raw_unfiltered[[2]]
  )
)

keep_row <- (
  !is.na(genotype_check) &
  genotype_check != "" &
  !is.na(rep_check)
)

raw_2022 <- raw_unfiltered[
  keep_row,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(raw_2022) != 92) {
  stop(
    "Expected 92 biological rows after filtering; found ",
    nrow(raw_2022),
    "."
  )
}

standardize_raw_genotype <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace(
    x,
    "_01$",
    ""
  )
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(
    x,
    "[^A-Za-z0-9]",
    ""
  )

  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "GA2018001" ~ "GA201800",
    x == "GA2018081" ~ "GA201808",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

fiber <- tibble::tibble(
  genotype = standardize_raw_genotype(
    raw_2022[[1]]
  ),
  field_rep_inferred = suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(
      raw_2022[[2]]
    )
  ),

  hvi_microgin_UHML =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[38]]
    ),

  afis_microgin_Lw =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[45]]
    ),

  afis_microgin_UQLw =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[47]]
    ),

  afis_microgin_Ln =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[49]]
    ),

  afis_microgin_SFCn =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[51]]
    ),

  afis_microgin_L5 =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[52]]
    ),

  fibrogram_microgin_UHMLf =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[64]]
    ),

  fibrogram_microgin_UQLf =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[66]]
    ),

  fibrogram_microgin_SFCf =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[69]]
    ),

  hvi_classing_UHML =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[72]]
    )
)

fiber_yarn <- yarn |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    fiber,
    by = c(
      "genotype",
      "field_rep_inferred"
    )
  )

if (
  nrow(fiber_yarn) != 92 ||
  any(
    is.na(
      fiber_yarn$hvi_microgin_UHML
    )
  )
) {
  stop(
    "The 2022 matched fiber-yarn join is incomplete."
  )
}

formal_fiber_yarn <- fiber_yarn |>
  dplyr::filter(
    material_type == "NIIL",
    qtl_status %in% c(
      "Negative",
      "Positive"
    )
  ) |>
  droplevels()
```

# 8. Import stage-wide AFIS data for Figures 1 and 1.2

```{r stage-data}
afis_candidates <- list.files(
  paths$data_processed,
  pattern = "afis.*2022.*\\.csv$|2022.*afis.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

required_stage_patterns <- c(
  "Bale",
  "Opened",
  "Carded",
  "Sliver"
)

stage_file <- NA_character_
stage_data <- NULL

for (candidate in afis_candidates) {

  candidate_data <- tryCatch(
    readr::read_csv(
      candidate,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(candidate_data)) {
    next
  }

  candidate_names <- names(
    candidate_data
  )

  has_all_stages <- all(
    vapply(
      required_stage_patterns,
      function(stage_name) {
        any(
          stringr::str_detect(
            candidate_names,
            stringr::regex(
              stage_name,
              ignore_case = TRUE
            )
          )
        )
      },
      logical(1)
    )
  )

  if (has_all_stages) {
    stage_file <- candidate
    stage_data <- candidate_data
    break
  }
}

if (is.null(stage_data)) {
  warning(
    "No processed 2022 AFIS wide file with Bale, Opened, Carded, and Sliver columns was found. ",
    "Figures 1 and 1.2 will be skipped."
  )
}
```

```{r stage-metadata}
figure_1 <- NULL
figure_1_2 <- NULL

if (!is.null(stage_data)) {

  sample_key_file <- first_existing_file(
    paths$data_processed,
    c(
      "^sample_key_2022.*\\.csv$"
    )
  )

  if (
    !("qtl_status" %in% names(stage_data)) &&
    !is.na(sample_key_file)
  ) {

    sample_key <- readr::read_csv(
      sample_key_file,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )

    stage_id_col <- find_matching_column(
      names(stage_data),
      c(
        "^field_sample_id$",
        "field.*sample.*id",
        "^sample_id$"
      )
    )

    key_id_col <- find_matching_column(
      names(sample_key),
      c(
        "^field_sample_id$",
        "field.*sample.*id",
        "^sample_id$"
      )
    )

    stage_genotype_col <- find_matching_column(
      names(stage_data),
      c(
        "^genotype$"
      )
    )

    key_genotype_col <- find_matching_column(
      names(sample_key),
      c(
        "^genotype$"
      )
    )

    if (
      !is.na(stage_id_col) &&
      !is.na(key_id_col)
    ) {

      stage_data <- stage_data |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          .join_id = clean_identifier(
            .data[[stage_id_col]]
          )
        ) |>
        dplyr::left_join(
          sample_key |>
            dplyr::mutate(
              .join_id = clean_identifier(
                .data[[key_id_col]]
              )
            ) |>
            dplyr::select(
              .join_id,
              dplyr::any_of(
                c(
                  "background",
                  "nil_set",
                  "qtl_status",
                  "material_type",
                  "field_rep_inferred",
                  "genotype"
                )
              )
            ),
          by = ".join_id"
        )

    } else if (
      !is.na(stage_genotype_col) &&
      !is.na(key_genotype_col)
    ) {

      stage_data <- stage_data |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          .join_genotype = clean_identifier(
            .data[[stage_genotype_col]]
          )
        ) |>
        dplyr::left_join(
          sample_key |>
            dplyr::mutate(
              .join_genotype = clean_identifier(
                .data[[key_genotype_col]]
              )
            ) |>
            dplyr::select(
              .join_genotype,
              dplyr::any_of(
                c(
                  "background",
                  "nil_set",
                  "qtl_status",
                  "material_type",
                  "field_rep_inferred"
                )
              )
            ),
          by = ".join_genotype"
        )
    }
  }
}
```

# 9. Figure 1 — AFIS processing-stage response

```{r figure-1, fig.show='hold'}
if (!is.null(stage_data)) {

  find_stage_column <- function(
    data_names,
    stage_regex,
    trait_regex
  ) {

    hits <- data_names[
      stringr::str_detect(
        data_names,
        stringr::regex(
          stage_regex,
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) &
      stringr::str_detect(
        data_names,
        stringr::regex(
          trait_regex,
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      )
    ]

    if (length(hits) == 0) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }

    hits[[1]]
  }

  stage_names <- names(
    stage_data
  )

  trait_map <- tibble::tribble(
    ~trait_label, ~trait_regex,
    "UQL(w)", "UQL.?w|UQL_w",
    "L5", "L5",
    "SFC(n)", "SFC.?n|SFC_n",
    "Nep count", "Nep.*count|Neps"
  )

  stage_map <- tibble::tribble(
    ~processing_stage, ~stage_regex,
    "Bale", "^Bale|Bale",
    "Opened", "Opened|Open",
    "Carded", "Carded|Card",
    "Sliver", "Sliver"
  )

  plot_specs <- tidyr::crossing(
    trait_map,
    stage_map
  ) |>
    dplyr::rowwise() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      column_name = find_stage_column(
        data_names = stage_names,
        stage_regex = stage_regex,
        trait_regex = trait_regex
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(
        column_name
      )
    )

  stage_long <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
    plot_specs,
    function(
      trait_label,
      trait_regex,
      processing_stage,
      stage_regex,
      column_name
    ) {

      tibble::tibble(
        trait = trait_label,
        processing_stage = processing_stage,
        value = as.numeric(
          stage_data[[column_name]]
        )
      )
    }
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      processing_stage = factor(
        processing_stage,
        levels = c(
          "Bale",
          "Opened",
          "Carded",
          "Sliver"
        )
      )
    )

  stage_summary <- stage_long |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      trait,
      processing_stage
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = sum(
        !is.na(
          value
        )
      ),
      mean = mean(
        value,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      se = stats::sd(
        value,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) /
        sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  figure_1 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    stage_summary,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = processing_stage,
      y = mean,
      group = 1
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line() +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      size = 2.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
      ggplot2::aes(
        ymin = mean - se,
        ymax = mean + se
      ),
      width = 0.10
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      ~ trait,
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 2
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Figure 1. Fiber properties change across MiniSpin processing stages",
      subtitle = "2022 matched AFIS samples; means ± SE",
      x = "Processing stage",
      y = "AFIS trait value"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(
      base_size = 12
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )

  print(figure_1)

  save_meeting_figure(
    figure_1,
    "Figure_1_AFIS_processing_stage_response",
    width = 10,
    height = 7
  )
}
```

# 10. Figure 1.2 — QTL-associated fiber phenotypes persist through processing

```{r figure-1-2}
if (
  !is.null(stage_data) &&
  "qtl_status" %in% names(stage_data)
) {

  stage_qtl_data <- stage_data

  if ("material_type" %in% names(stage_qtl_data)) {
    stage_qtl_data <- stage_qtl_data |>
      dplyr::filter(
        material_type == "NIIL"
      )
  }

  stage_qtl_data <- stage_qtl_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      qtl_status %in% c(
        "Negative",
        "Positive"
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      qtl_status = factor(
        qtl_status,
        levels = c(
          "Negative",
          "Positive"
        )
      )
    )

  if (nrow(stage_qtl_data) > 0) {

    qtl_plot_specs <- plot_specs

    stage_qtl_long <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
      qtl_plot_specs,
      function(
        trait_label,
        trait_regex,
        processing_stage,
        stage_regex,
        column_name
      ) {

        tibble::tibble(
          qtl_status = stage_qtl_data$qtl_status,
          trait = trait_label,
          processing_stage = processing_stage,
          value = as.numeric(
            stage_qtl_data[[column_name]]
          )
        )
      }
    ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        processing_stage = factor(
          processing_stage,
          levels = c(
            "Bale",
            "Opened",
            "Carded",
            "Sliver"
          )
        )
      )

    stage_qtl_summary <- stage_qtl_long |>
      dplyr::group_by(
        trait,
        processing_stage,
        qtl_status
      ) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        n = sum(
          !is.na(value)
        ),
        mean = mean(
          value,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        se = stats::sd(
          value,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) /
          sqrt(n),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    figure_1_2 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      stage_qtl_summary,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = processing_stage,
        y = mean,
        group = qtl_status,
        shape = qtl_status,
        linetype = qtl_status
      )
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_line() +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        size = 2.5
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
        ggplot2::aes(
          ymin = mean - se,
          ymax = mean + se
        ),
        width = 0.10
      ) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(
        ~ trait,
        scales = "free_y",
        ncol = 2
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = "Figure 1.2. QTL-associated fiber phenotypes persist across processing stages",
        subtitle = "2022 NIIL AFIS samples; qFL-Chr.25 positive vs negative means ± SE",
        x = "Processing stage",
        y = "AFIS trait value",
        shape = "qFL-Chr.25",
        linetype = "qFL-Chr.25"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(
        base_size = 12
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
      )

    print(figure_1_2)

    save_meeting_figure(
      figure_1_2,
      "Figure_1_2_AFIS_processing_stage_QTL_persistence",
      width = 10,
      height = 7.5
    )
  }

} else if (!is.null(stage_data)) {

  warning(
    "Figure 1.2 was skipped because qtl_status could not be resolved in the stage-wide AFIS dataset."
  )
}
```

# 11. Figure 2 — Overall qFL-Chr.25 effects on primary yarn traits

```{r figure-2-data}
primary_yarn_traits <- c(
  "skein_mn_tex",
  "yarn_tenacity_cn_tex",
  "yarn_elongation_pct",
  "yarn_evenness_cv_pct",
  "yarn_thin_50",
  "yarn_thick_50",
  "yarn_neps_200",
  "yarn_hairiness"
)

trait_labels <- c(
  skein_mn_tex = "Skein strength",
  yarn_tenacity_cn_tex = "Single-end tenacity",
  yarn_elongation_pct = "Yarn elongation",
  yarn_evenness_cv_pct = "Evenness CV",
  yarn_thin_50 = "Thin places",
  yarn_thick_50 = "Thick places",
  yarn_neps_200 = "Neps +200%",
  yarn_hairiness = "Hairiness"
)

fit_qtl_contrast <- function(
  trait_name
) {

  model_formula <- stats::as.formula(
    paste0(
      trait_name,
      " ~ background * qtl_status + ",
      "field_rep + (1 | pair_id)"
    )
  )

  fit <- lmerTest::lmer(
    model_formula,
    data = formal_yarn,
    REML = TRUE,
    control = lme4::lmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(
        maxfun = 100000
      )
    )
  )

  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
    fit,
    ~ qtl_status
  )

  contrast_result <- as.data.frame(
    emmeans::contrast(
      emm,
      method = list(
        "Positive - Negative" = c(-1, 1)
      )
    )
  )

  estimate <- contrast_result$estimate
  se <- contrast_result$SE

  tibble::tibble(
    trait = trait_name,
    estimate = estimate,
    se = se,
    df = contrast_result$df,
    p_value = contrast_result$p.value,
    lower = estimate - 1.96 * se,
    upper = estimate + 1.96 * se,
    singular = lme4::isSingular(
      fit,
      tol = 1e-4
    )
  )
}

overall_qtl_effects <- purrr::map_dfr(
  primary_yarn_traits,
  fit_qtl_contrast
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    fdr_p = stats::p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    trait_label = unname(
      trait_labels[
        trait
      ]
    )
  )

readr::write_csv(
  overall_qtl_effects,
  file.path(
    meeting_table_dir,
    "Figure_2_overall_yarn_qtl_effects.csv"
  )
)
```

```{r figure-2}
trait_sd <- formal_yarn |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(
        primary_yarn_traits
      ),
      ~ stats::sd(
        .x,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = "trait",
    values_to = "trait_sd"
  )

overall_qtl_effects_plot <- overall_qtl_effects |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    trait_sd,
    by = "trait"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    standardized_effect = estimate / trait_sd,
    standardized_lower = lower / trait_sd,
    standardized_upper = upper / trait_sd,
    trait_label = factor(
      trait_label,
      levels = rev(
        unname(
          trait_labels
        )
      )
    )
  )

n_fdr_sig <- sum(
  overall_qtl_effects$fdr_p < 0.05,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

figure_2_subtitle <- if (n_fdr_sig == 0) {
  paste(
    "QTL-positive minus QTL-negative; standardized effects with approximate 95% CI.",
    "No overall yarn-trait contrast remained significant after FDR correction."
  )
} else {
  paste0(
    "QTL-positive minus QTL-negative; standardized effects with approximate 95% CI. ",
    n_fdr_sig,
    " trait(s) remained significant after FDR correction."
  )
}

figure_2 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  overall_qtl_effects_plot,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = standardized_effect,
    y = trait_label
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbarh(
    ggplot2::aes(
      xmin = standardized_lower,
      xmax = standardized_upper
    ),
    height = 0.16
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Figure 2. Overall qFL-Chr.25 effects on primary yarn traits",
    subtitle = figure_2_subtitle,
    x = "Standardized QTL effect (SD units)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Raw nominal contrasts are shown; FDR-adjusted inference is summarized in the subtitle."
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

figure_2

save_meeting_figure(
  figure_2,
  "Figure_2_overall_yarn_QTL_effects_updated",
  width = 10,
  height = 6.5
)
```

# 14. Figure 5 — Fiber-to-yarn correlation heatmap with biologically ordered yarn traits

```{r figure-5-data}
heatmap_yarn_traits <- c(
  "yarn_tenacity_cn_tex",
  "skein_mn_tex",
  "yarn_elongation_pct",
  "yarn_evenness_cv_pct",
  "yarn_thin_50",
  "yarn_thick_50",
  "yarn_neps_200",
  "yarn_hairiness"
)

heatmap_yarn_order <- c(
  "Single-end tenacity",
  "Skein strength",
  "Yarn elongation",
  "Evenness CV",
  "Thin places",
  "Thick places",
  "Neps +200%",
  "Hairiness"
)

heatmap_data <- purrr::map_dfr(
  heatmap_yarn_traits,
  function(yarn_trait) {

    purrr::map_dfr(
      core_fiber_traits,
      function(fiber_trait) {

        x <- formal_fiber_yarn[[fiber_trait]]
        y <- formal_fiber_yarn[[yarn_trait]]

        complete <- stats::complete.cases(
          x,
          y
        )

        test <- stats::cor.test(
          x[complete],
          y[complete],
          method = "pearson"
        )

        tibble::tibble(
          fiber_trait = fiber_trait,
          yarn_trait = yarn_trait,
          n = sum(
            complete
          ),
          r = unname(
            test$estimate
          ),
          p_value = test$p.value
        )
      }
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    yarn_trait
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    fdr_p = stats::p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    fiber_label = unname(
      core_fiber_labels[
        fiber_trait
      ]
    ),
    yarn_label = unname(
      trait_labels[
        yarn_trait
      ]
    ),
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      fdr_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      fdr_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
      fdr_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

readr::write_csv(
  heatmap_data,
  file.path(
    meeting_table_dir,
    "Figure_5_fiber_yarn_correlations_core_panel.csv"
  )
)
```

# 15. Figure 6 — DP213 effect profile with clearer interpretation

```{r figure-6-data}
dp213_traits <- c(
  core_fiber_traits,
  "yarn_tenacity_cn_tex",
  "skein_mn_tex",
  "yarn_elongation_pct",
  "yarn_evenness_cv_pct",
  "yarn_thin_50",
  "yarn_neps_200",
  "yarn_hairiness"
)

dp213_labels <- c(
  core_fiber_labels,
  yarn_tenacity_cn_tex = "Yarn tenacity",
  skein_mn_tex = "Skein strength",
  yarn_elongation_pct = "Yarn elongation",
  yarn_evenness_cv_pct = "Evenness CV",
  yarn_thin_50 = "Thin places",
  yarn_neps_200 = "Yarn neps",
  yarn_hairiness = "Hairiness"
)

dp213_long <- formal_fiber_yarn |>
  dplyr::filter(
    nil_set == "DP213"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    qtl_status,
    dplyr::all_of(
      dp213_traits
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(
      dp213_traits
    ),
    names_to = "trait",
    values_to = "value"
  )

dp213_means <- dp213_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    trait,
    qtl_status
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_value = mean(
      value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = qtl_status,
    values_from = mean_value
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    raw_difference = Positive - Negative
  )

formal_trait_sd <- formal_fiber_yarn |>
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(
      dp213_traits
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::everything(),
      ~ stats::sd(
        .x,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = "trait",
    values_to = "formal_sd"
  )

dp213_effect_profile <- dp213_means |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    formal_trait_sd,
    by = "trait"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    standardized_difference = raw_difference / formal_sd,
    trait_label = unname(
      dp213_labels[
        trait
      ]
    ),
    domain = dplyr::case_when(
      trait %in% core_fiber_traits ~ "Fiber",
      TRUE ~ "Yarn"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      standardized_difference
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    trait_label = factor(
      trait_label,
      levels = trait_label
    )
  )

readr::write_csv(
  dp213_effect_profile,
  file.path(
    meeting_table_dir,
    "Figure_6_DP213_standardized_effect_profile_core_panel.csv"
  )
)
```
